text: In July 2016 Investcorp and Mubadala Development Company, the Abu Dhabi-based investment and development company, agreed for Mubadala to acquire a 20% interest in Investcorp; when Investcorp delisted from the Bahrain Bourse in 2021 to become a private company, a report still described Mubadala Investment Company as its biggest shareholder.
short: Mubadala agreed in 2016 to take 20% of Investcorp and was still its biggest shareholder at the 2021 delisting.

source.name: Mubadala press release: Investcorp strengthens shareholder base with agreed investment from Mubadala Development Company
source.quote: have agreed for Mubadala to acquire a 20% interest in the company
source.note: The release says Mubadala would acquire 'a 9.99% ownership stake immediately, with a further 10.01% following necessary regulatory approvals'. Mubadala Development Company is the Abu Dhabi state investment company now known as Mubadala Investment Company.

additionalSources.name: The National: Investcorp announces intention to delist from Bahrain Bourse to pursue 'agile' growth
additionalSources.quote: The alternative asset manager, which counts Mubadala Investment Company as its biggest shareholder and manages $35.4 billion of assets, has received shareholders’ approval for a board recommendation to delist
additionalSources.note: Named-press confirmation that Mubadala was still Investcorp's biggest shareholder in 2021, when Investcorp converted into a closed shareholding (private) company.
